$comment: Glossary for L-13 (doc 06 §3.7, §4.3; doc 08 §7.2; R64). Sources: doc 08 §7.2.1 tables T-A–T-E (de column = the app's own names from Localizable.xcstrings), research 05 §8 (de row: KI-Aussprache (Wort)), §7.2.2 website rules ①–③ and fix X7 (the app's tip says 'Doppelklicke' — a mouse word; the site writes doppeltippen), §7.3 de row (du; 'nach rechts wischen'; 'doppeltippen').

required: kickers and quota-table rows use the app's names (rule ①). The full lookup name 'Doppeltippen zum Nachschlagen (KI-Bedeutung)' is 29+ characters, over the 24 wu kicker cap (doc 08 §7.6), so the kicker carries 'Nachschlagen' and the H3 / table row carry the full app name. 'Action Flow' stays the App Store name (doc 08 D3, §7.2.3); the app's local name 'Aktionsfluss' is quoted once in features[chunks].text.

contains: app button and setting names quoted verbatim in sentences, including the app's own capitalisation ('Jetzt Upgraden', 'Kauf Wiederherstellen', 'AI-Syntax-Erklärung abrufen') so readers find the buttons; the capitalisation is reported to the app side, not corrected on the site.

banned: X7 mouse wording, the left swipe (removes a translation, F14), a single tap for lookup, a non-app spelling of 'Weitere Definitionen'. allowInKeys exempts nothing: de has no Chrome extension page (R1).

banned.note: touch gesture, not a mouse double-click (doc 08 §7.2.2 X7: the app's tip says 'Doppelklicke')
the gesture is a right swipe; a left swipe removes the translation (F14)

banned.use: tippe doppelt auf ein Wort / auf ein Wort doppeltippen
banned.note: lookup is a double tap, never a single tap (doc 08 §1.1 lookup row)
